The simulation shows a demo car: scan it to see its ECUs and their fault memory.

Every value read is sent with its own time, at the read rate: Grafana gets the same data as the CSV.
The queue never deletes points by itself. It may use all the free space except %1$s kept for the phone; when that is reached, new points are no longer queued (the CSV recording still has them).
